The proposed supplier and required hypotheses are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-48.notes.md) and [cross-batch evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-48.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
